arguments.prompt:
Create a new front-facing full-body appearance concept of this EXACT adult female boxer. Preserve her face, warm medium skin, black high ponytail, body proportions and restrained athletic musculature. Straight-on view, feet planted, arms relaxed slightly clear of torso, entire hair and both soles visible. Keep the polished manhwa game illustration, crisp ink contours and cel-painted material shading of the reference.
Dress her as a distinctive urban fantasy RPG boxing protagonist. Build style from premium boxing sportswear, tailoring and strong graphic shapes. An open cropped sleeveless ring jacket in midnight indigo, a sculpted folded fabric collar and hood resting behind the neck, broad off-white shoulder-to-side fabric panels edged with fine cyan piping, a small angular silver embroidered crest over one chest, over her charcoal sports bra. Maintain bare arms and a clear waist silhouette. High-waisted charcoal satin boxing trunks ending above mid-thigh, wide ribbed indigo waistband with a small centered silver geometric crest, angular off-white side stripes with thin cyan edging and subtle indigo paneling. Both hands wear recognizably padded CLOSED boxing gloves with rounded knuckles and attached thumb, charcoal leather, indigo wrist cuffs, a clean cyan angular seam and small silver embossed crest. Glove proportions like real competition gloves; knuckles are padded leather, not armored gauntlets. Short white fabric wrist wraps show just above the cuffs. Slender mid-calf lace-up boxing boots, flexible black textile/leather, indigo ankle bands and off-white side stripes, light thin soles.
A coherent recognizable outfit with 3 focal accents: jacket collar silhouette, glove shape, waistband crest. Express RPG rarity with precise seam design, embroidered motifs and a restrained cyan inlay, never extra bulk. Keep clean readable shapes at phone size. No metal armor plates, shoulder armor, shin guards, tactical pouches, weapons, cape, skirt, heels, oversized gauntlets, heavy combat boots, excessive belts, flame effects, aura, large glowing effects, written text, UI or labels. No additional characters. Plain soft light gray background, simple flat studio light. Only one full body frontal character.
